subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#4 NOT MET — The live preview tests (live_preview block with preview_token, live_preview absent when token unset, setHost priority) exist ONLY in contentstack.spec.ts.bak, NOT in the actual test file contentstack.spec.ts. A search for 'live', 'preview', 'setHost', and 'PREVIEW' in contentstack.spec.ts returned zero matches. AC#4 explicitly requires tests at src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts (the actual test file), not a .bak backup. The diff shows no changes to contentstack.spec.ts at all — only a new .bak file was created.
issues.suggestedFix: Move the 3 live preview test cases from contentstack.spec.ts.bak into contentstack.spec.ts (the actual test file). Delete the .bak file.

issues.description: The contentstack mock in the actual test file does not include an `addParam` method. setCommonConfig calls `(query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash)` when live_preview.preview_hash is present. If the live preview tests are moved into this file and any test passes live_preview through a public function (getEntry, etc.), the test will crash with 'addParam is not a function'.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `addParam: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),` to the mock Stack object in the jest.mock factory function.

issues.description: No test verifies that live_preview context flows through a public function (getEntry, getSingleEntry, etc.) to the Contentstack query's addParam method. The implementation in contentstack.ts correctly destructures live_preview in all 5 public functions and forwards it via rest operators to setCommonConfig, which calls addParam('live_preview', preview_hash). But without an end-to-end test, a regression that removes the forwarding would not be caught. AC#3 requires that preview context 'can flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig' — this must be tested, not just implemented.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test that calls getEntry (or similar) with a live_preview parameter containing preview_hash and asserts that the mock's addParam method was called with ('live_preview', '<hash value>').

issues.description: A .bak backup file is committed to the repository and tracked by git. This is dead weight — it's a duplicate of the old test file with live preview tests added. It should not be in version control.
